plugins.name: roblox-dev
plugins.description: Roblox/Luau game development toolkit: exploit-proof remotes, safe DataStores, strict typing, performance, architecture, UI and testing patterns from real production game development. Skills auto-activate when you work on Luau code; commands scaffold projects and systems.

skills.name: luau-strict-typing
skills.description: Luau strict mode typing patterns — annotations, narrowing Instance? results, forward declarations, typed remotes, generics, and fixing common --!strict type errors. Use when writing Luau code, enabling --!strict, or resolving Luau type-checker warnings in Roblox projects.
headings: Forward Declarations for Mutually Recursive Functions
Practical Adoption Path for Untyped Codebases

skills.name: new-system
skills.description: Generate a complete, secure client/server gameplay system for Roblox — shared types, validated server module, client controller, and remote registration in one pass. Use when adding a feature like a shop, inventory, combat ability, quest, or any system that spans client and server.

skills.name: review
skills.description: Run a structured security, data-safety, performance and typing review of Roblox/Luau code using the roblox-reviewer agent. Use when asked to review Roblox code, audit a game for exploits or leaks, or before shipping a system.

skills.name: roblox-architecture
skills.description: Roblox project architecture — ModuleScript patterns over _G, client/server/shared layout, bootstrapping, CollectionService managers, remote organization, and Rojo-friendly structure. Use when starting a Roblox project, adding a new system, restructuring spaghetti scripts, or deciding where code should live.
headings: Remotes as a Typed API Boundary
Where Does This Code Go? (decision table)

skills.name: roblox-datastores
skills.description: Safe player data persistence in Roblox — DataStore retry/backoff, session locking, autosaves, BindToClose, schema versioning and migration. Use when writing or reviewing any code that touches DataStoreService, player profiles, saving/loading, or data loss bugs.
headings: Roblox DataStores: Data Loss Is a Design Failure
What NOT To Do (review red flags)

skills.name: roblox-performance
skills.description: Roblox performance and memory patterns — connection leak prevention, per-frame allocation discipline, StreamingEnabled, network traffic reduction, instance budgets, and profiling. Use when diagnosing lag/memory growth, writing RunService loops, or reviewing Roblox code for performance.

skills.name: roblox-security
skills.description: Server-authoritative security patterns for Roblox games — validating RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions, preventing exploits, rate limiting, and never trusting the client. Use when writing or reviewing any code that touches RemoteEvents, RemoteFunctions, player input, currency, damage, inventory, or purchases.
headings: Roblox Security: Never Trust the Client

skills.name: roblox-testing
skills.description: Testing and QA workflows for Roblox games — gated cheat remotes for live-state QA, TestEZ unit tests, pure-logic module design for testability, and multi-client playtesting. Use when setting up testing, debugging state-dependent bugs, verifying gameplay systems, or reviewing QA tooling.
headings: Designing for Testability: Pure Core, Thin Shell

skills.name: roblox-ui
skills.description: Roblox UI and visual effects patterns — responsive scaling, TweenService animation, CanvasGroup clipping, ViewportFrames, particle gotchas, and juicy game-feel effects. Use when building or reviewing ScreenGuis, HUDs, shop/inventory interfaces, animations, or VFX in Roblox.
headings: CanvasGroup: the clipping and fade workhorse

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Scaffold a professional Roblox project with Rojo, Wally, Selene, StyLua, strict Luau, and GitHub Actions CI. Use when starting a new Roblox project or adding proper tooling to an existing one.
